description: Check the processing status of a media file. States: pending → transcribing → analyzing → processed (or failed). Poll this after upload_media until state is 'processed', then use get_transcript and get_media_insights to retrieve results. For a video, data.thumbnail has the thumbnail: url, source (auto or custom), pending while a requested frame is being made, and error if that frame failed.

mediaId.description: The mediaId (12 characters) from list_media, search_media or an upload result. Not the media name and not a database _id.

name: get_media_status

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
